props.label: Checkout flow
props.source:
@startuml
actor Customer
participant "Web app" as Web
participant "Checkout API" as API
participant "Order service" as Orders
participant "Payment gateway" as Gateway
Customer -> Web : Place order
Web -> API : POST /checkout
API -> Orders : create order
API -> Gateway : authorize payment
Gateway --> API : authorized
API --> Web : order confirmed
@enduml

props.text: Checkout spec · Order creation (docs/specs/checkout.md · §3.2 · lines 40–52): an order is created only after the payment gateway authorizes the payment.
